headlines.title: Visa Forecasts U.S. Holiday Spending to Rise 4.5% as Consumers Keep the Holidays a Priority
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 05, 2026--U.S. consumers are poised to keep the registers ringing this holiday season. New research from Visa Business and Economic Insights (VBEI) forecasts U.S. holiday retail sales will rise 4.5% year-over-year in November and December, the strongest growth since 2021.

headlines.title: Visa Establishes Global Capability Hubs in Singapore to Build the Future of Global Commerce
headlines.summary: Visa (NYSE: V), a global leader in digital payments, today announced the establishment of six global capability hubs at its new Solution Center in Singapore. Spanning AI, cybersecurity, quantum computing and next-generation payments, the hubs will develop technologies and solutions designed for deployment across Visa's global network.

headlines.title: Verifone adds adaptive anti-fraud screening, powered by Visa
headlines.summary: Real-time risk scoring protects revenue across in-store, online and mobile payments Security that protects revenue: real-time fraud screening across every channel, built into Verifone’s gateways Verifone and Visa together help make the world a safer place to transact NEW YORK, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Verifone, a global leader in payments and commerce technologies, today announced it has deployed Featurespace, a Visa solution, in its anti-fraud framework.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
